title: Point of Sale — the menu and the order
summary: The till. Tap products to build an order (a quick sale at the counter, or a table's or a named customer's bill), choose sizes and add-ons, weigh what is sold by the kilo, add a meal deal, a note, a discount or a customer, then take the money.

who.can: Everything on the till: sell, discount with no limit, approve other people's discounts and over-stock sales with their PIN, cancel bills with items, cancel pre-orders, take offline sales off the till, edit tables, see the cost of a sale.
The same as the owner on this screen.
The same as the owner on this screen (discounts, approvals, cancelling bills and pre-orders, edit tables, cost of a sale).

Sell, take payment every way, keep bills open, split and move bills, give discounts up to the discount limit, add customers and addresses, take and collect pre-orders, give away a staff meal / on the house / sample, open, close and hand over their own drawer, clock in and out.
who.cannot: Give a discount over the limit without a manager's PIN; cancel a bill that has items on it; change the discount on a printed bill; cancel a pre-order; take a refused offline sale off the till; edit tables; see costs.

who.can: The same selling as a cashier, and the drawer.
who.cannot: Give any discount (no Discount link), and everything a cashier cannot.

get_there: Menu → Operations → POS. A cashier lands here after signing in. Also: Sales → Open POS.
before: At least one product with a price on a way of selling (Products & Recipes). Otherwise the till shows "No products to sell yet".
The device must be at a branch. At the central kitchen the till asks which branch to sell at.
To take cash the drawer must be open (see "Point of Sale — the drawer, clocking and printing"). A card sale needs no drawer.

parts.name: Top bar
parts.shows: Tabs for Tables and Menu (only when the café has tables, or you may edit them), the open bills as chips, the Pre-orders button, the offline warning, the drawer button, the clock, printing and full screen.

controls.label: Tables
controls.does: Shows the floor: every table and the bills kept by name.
controls.rules: Shown only when there are tables or you may edit them. The till remembers the last tab on this device (for a year).

controls.label: Menu
controls.does: Shows the products to sell.

controls.label: Quick sale
controls.does: Goes back to the counter order (not a bill). If a bill was on screen with changes, they are saved first (or kept on the till when offline).
controls.rules: The number on it is how many items the quick sale holds.

controls.label: (a bill chip: table or name, and its total)
controls.does: Opens that open bill. A receipt icon and a yellow chip mean the bill was printed and waits for payment ("Waiting for payment"); otherwise it is "Ordering".
controls.rules: Ordered by table, then by when opened. Other tills' bills appear here every 15 seconds.

controls.label: Pre-orders
controls.does: Opens the pre-orders (see "Point of Sale — pre-orders"). The number is how many wait to be collected.
controls.rules: Shown only when pre-orders are switched on in the database.

controls.label: Session {no} / Open the drawer
controls.does: Opens the drawer window. Shows a lock when the drawer is closed ("Open the drawer"), an open lock with the session number when open.

controls.label: Clock in or out
controls.does: Opens the clock window (clock icon).
controls.rules: Hidden when the café uses clock screens and this till is not one of them.

controls.label: Printing
controls.does: Opens "Printing on this till". The icon is lit when "Print by itself" is on.

controls.label: Full screen
controls.does: Fills the screen with the till; press again to leave full screen.

controls.label: Till at
controls.does: Changes the branch this device sells at.
controls.rules: Shown only when the café has more than one branch.
controls.after: The till reloads with that branch's menu, bills and drawer.

parts.name: Search and keys
parts.shows: A search box over the products, a "× n" sign when a number was typed first, and a "?" button for the keys.

controls.label: Search products…  ( / )
controls.does: Finds products by any of their names (English, Arabic, Kurdish, the size name). The arrows choose among what is found; Enter adds it. "3*latte" adds three. A barcode typed (4–32 letters or digits) and Enter, when no product matches, looks the barcode up.
controls.rules: While searching, every section is searched, and the section and category chips are hidden.

controls.label: Clear
controls.does: Empties the search.
Shows or hides "Keys on the till".

controls.label: A–Z
controls.does: Find a product by its name (typing anywhere on the till starts a search).
Choose among what is found (also ← →; reversed in Arabic and Kurdish).

controls.label: Enter
controls.does: Add it to the order.
How many of the next one: 3, then a product, adds three.
controls.rules: Up to two digits. Forgotten after 10 seconds. Backspace takes a digit off.

controls.label: F2
controls.does: Take cash: opens the payment window on Cash; Enter then takes the exact amount.
controls.rules: Not while a window is open or the order is empty. On a delivery platform's order it opens the platform payment instead.

controls.label: F4
controls.does: Take a card.

controls.label: Esc
controls.does: Clear what was typed (search and the number). In a window, closes it.
Go to the search.

controls.label: (barcode scanner)
controls.does: A scan anywhere on the till adds the product with that barcode; a scale's label adds the size and its weight. A product with add-ons opens its sheet; a product sold by weight with no weight on the label asks for the weight.

parts.name: Sections, deals and categories
parts.shows: Section tabs (e.g. Café / Bakery) when the menu has more than one section, a row of meal deals on now, and category chips with how many products each has.

controls.label: All (sections)
controls.does: Shows every section's products.
controls.rules: Shown only with two or more sections. The choice is kept on this device.

controls.label: (a section)
controls.does: Shows only that section's products (and products in no section). The number is how many.

controls.label: (a deal tile: name and price)
controls.does: Starts the deal: each of its places in turn asks for a size and add-ons (a place with one size and nothing to choose is filled by itself); then the deal goes on the order as one block at the deal's price.
controls.rules: Only on a quick sale, and only deals sold on the order's way of selling. Products sold by weight are never in a deal.

controls.label: All (categories)
controls.does: All products of the section.

controls.label: ★ Favourites
controls.does: Only favourite products.
controls.rules: Shown when any product is a favourite.

controls.label: (a category)
controls.does: Only that category.

controls.label: No category
controls.does: Products with no category.
controls.rules: Shown only when some products have a category and some do not.

parts.name: Products grid
parts.shows: A tile per product that has a price on the order's way of selling: picture (or initials), name, price ("from …" when sizes differ, "/ kg" for sold by weight), how many sizes ("{n} options"), ★ for a favourite, "−{n}%" for a markdown, and a count of how many are on the order.

controls.label: (a product tile)
controls.does: One size and no add-ons: added at once (or the weight is asked first if sold by weight). Otherwise the size and add-ons sheet opens.
controls.rules: A product already on the order with the same add-ons adds one to that line; a weighed product is always a new line.

parts.name: Size and add-ons sheet
parts.shows: The product's name, its sizes with their prices, then each add-on group for that size: groups that must be answered first (marked "must pick" until answered, then ✓), and optional ones folded shut ("(optional)"). Each group says what it asks: "Choose {n}", "Up to {n}", "{min} to {max}", "At least {n}", "As many as you like". Each add-on shows its price ("+500") or "free".

controls.label: (a size)
controls.does: Chooses the size. A size with no add-ons is added at once.

controls.label: (an add-on)
controls.does: Adds it; tapped again takes one off. In a group of one choice, it replaces the other.
controls.rules: Up to 20 of one add-on.

controls.does: One more of that add-on (groups that allow more than one).

controls.label: Add · {price}
controls.does: Adds the size with its add-ons at the price shown (each one).
controls.rules: Off until every required group has what it asks. Enter on the sheet does the same.

controls.label: Close
controls.does: Closes without adding (also Esc or tapping outside).

parts.name: Weight sheet (sold by weight)
parts.shows: The product, "{price} a kilo", quick weights 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, a weight box with grams/kilos, and what it comes to.

controls.label: 100 g / 250 g / 500 g / 1 kg
controls.does: Adds that weight at once.

controls.label: Weight
controls.does: Type the weight.
controls.rules: From 1 g to 1,000 kg, to the gram.

controls.label: grams / kilos
controls.does: The unit of the number typed. Grams to begin with.

controls.label: Add
controls.does: Adds the line with that weight (or changes the weight of a line weighed again).

controls.label: Cancel
controls.does: Closes without adding.

parts.name: Order header
parts.shows: The order's title (Quick sale, the table, or the bill's name), its way of selling, "New bill" until a bill is saved, "Bill printed ×n" once printed, "Not saved" when a bill has changes not saved, "Opened by {name} · {n} min" for a bill, and the order's number (No.) the customer is called by.

controls.label: (way of selling: Dine-in, Takeaway, Direct delivery, a platform)
controls.does: Changes the order's way of selling: prices, packaging taken from stock, service charge and the products shown change with it.
controls.rules: On a quick sale, and on a new bill not at a table. Choosing a delivery platform drops any discount (a platform sets its own).

controls.label: Customer's name
controls.does: The name of a new bill kept for a customer (not at a table).
controls.rules: Up to 60 letters.

controls.label: Customer
controls.does: Opens the customer window to put a customer on the order (for points, rewards and delivery).
controls.rules: Not on a delivery platform's order.

controls.label: Change
controls.does: Opens the customer window when a customer is already on the order; shows their name, points and, for delivery, the address.

parts.name: Order lines
parts.shows: Each line: name, add-ons ("+ …"), price each (or "{price} a kilo"), its note, the quantity and the line's amount. A deal is one block with ★, its name, what it holds and its price. Empty: "Tap a product to add it." (and, the first time, "New here? Let us show you around this screen." with Show me around / No thanks).

controls.does: One less (aria: "One less …"). At zero the line goes.
One more (aria: "One more …").

controls.label: × (weighed line)
controls.does: Takes the weighed line off ("Take off …").

controls.label: (the weight, e.g. 250 g)
controls.does: Weigh {name} again: opens the weight sheet with the line's weight.

controls.label: × (deal)
controls.does: Takes the whole deal off ("Take off {deal}").
Add a note to the line.
controls.rules: Up to 200 letters, e.g. "no sugar, extra shot". Enter or OK saves; Esc closes.

controls.label: OK
controls.does: Saves the note.

parts.name: Discount
parts.shows: With a discount: Subtotal · {n} items, the discount boxes, the reason, and the Total. The discount is worked out as the books will round it.

controls.label: ＋ Discount
controls.does: Opens the discount row.
controls.who: Owner, general manager, branch manager, cashier (discount.apply). Not on a delivery platform's order.

controls.label: Discount as a percentage (%)
controls.does: Type a percentage; the amount is worked out and shown in the other box.
controls.rules: Above 0 and no more than 100%. The amount is rounded to the café's discount step (e.g. 250 IQD): "A percentage is rounded to the nearest {step}."

controls.label: Discount as an amount in IQD
controls.does: Type an amount off; the percentage is shown beside it.
controls.rules: Never more than the bill.

controls.label: ✕ (Remove the discount)
controls.does: Takes the discount off.

controls.label: Why?
controls.does: The reason, required: Staff meal, On the house, Regular customer, To make up for a complaint, Promotion, Other.
controls.rules: "Other" needs a few real words in "In a few words" (two words, six letters or more).

controls.label: In a few words
controls.does: The note for "Other".
controls.rules: Up to 300 letters.

controls.label: Ask a manager
controls.does: Shown when the discount is over your limit ("Over {cap}%: a manager approves it."). Opens "A manager approves the discount": the manager chooses their name (Manager) and types their PIN (4 to 8 digits), then Approve.
controls.after: The approval is kept with the sale; the order shows "Approved by {name}". It is good once and runs out after a while.

parts.name: Buttons under the total (quick sale)
parts.shows: Cash, Card and the café's other ways to pay (see "Point of Sale — taking payment"), then:

controls.label: Keep open, pay later
controls.does: Turns the quick sale into an open bill: type the customer's name and press Keep open, or tap a table under "Or at a table" (a table with a bill "has a bill; adds another", else "Free").
controls.rules: Not with a meal deal on the order. Not offline. Not on a delivery platform's order.
controls.after: A bill opens with these items; nothing reaches the books until it is paid. If the till prints by itself, the barista's ticket prints now.

controls.label: Give away…
controls.does: Opens "Give away" for what is on the order: choose Staff meal (For the staff, eaten or drunk here.), On the house (Free for a customer.) or Sample (A taste, to sell more.), type "Why (required)", then Give it away.
controls.rules: Only on a quick sale eaten in or taken away. Not offline. Over the loss limit, or using more than the books hold under a rule that asks, a manager approves it there with their name and PIN.
controls.after: Not a sale: no money. Stock used by the recipes (and add-ons) goes out; its cost goes to 6110 Staff meals, 6610 Complimentary items or 6620 Marketing samples (Cr 1200 Inventory). The order gets a number and, with the barista's ticket on, a ticket "Given away: {what}" prints. Shown on Inventory and the losses report.

controls.label: Clear
controls.does: Empties the quick sale. Nothing is recorded.

parts.name: Customer window
parts.shows: "Customer": find by phone, their points and rewards, notes, and for direct delivery where it goes.

controls.label: Their phone number
controls.does: Type the number any way (0770 123 4567, +964…, Arabic digits).

controls.label: Find
controls.does: Looks the number up. Found: name, phone, "{n} points", "{n} rewards to take". Not found: "Nobody has that number yet."

controls.label: Add them as a customer
controls.does: Opens the new customer form (Name, Phone, Notes about them) with Add the customer / Cancel.
controls.who: People with customer.edit: owner, managers, cashier, barista.
controls.after: The customer is saved and appears on Customers; the audit trail keeps it.

controls.label: Deliver to
controls.does: Choose one of their addresses (direct delivery only).

controls.label: + Add an address
controls.does: Adds an address: Name for it (Home, work), Address, How to find it, then Add the address.
controls.rules: At most 10 addresses a customer.

controls.label: Put them on the order
controls.does: Puts the customer on the order. A bill with no table and no name takes the customer's name.
controls.rules: Off for a customer put away, or for delivery without an address.

controls.label: Someone else
controls.does: Clears and searches again.

controls.label: Take {name} off the order
controls.does: Removes the customer from the order.

controls.label: Close
controls.does: Closes the window.

"{place} does not sell: the till is at a branch" and "Choose the branch this till is at." with a "Sell at {place}" button for each branch.
"Tap a product to add it." with the café's emblem.
Lines, Total · {n} items, the pay buttons and the order's other buttons. On a phone, a bar at the bottom shows the item count, title and total; tap it to jump to the order.

states.state: Nothing on this way of selling
states.looks: "Nothing on this channel has a price yet."
"Nothing matches that search."
Buttons are greyed while a save or payment is on its way; tiles cannot be tapped.
The till fetches today's prices every 10 minutes, when it comes back to the front, and at the hour the menu changes (an hour's price, a section, a deal). Nothing to do.

messages.do: Check the spelling or clear the search.

messages.when: No product has a price on the order's way of selling.
messages.do: Choose another way of selling, or a manager adds prices on Products & Recipes.

messages.text: Nobody has that number yet.
messages.do: Add them as a customer, or check the number.

messages.do: A manager brings them back on their Customers page.

messages.when: Direct delivery and the customer has no address.

Type the customer's phone number

Type the address

messages.text: Your previous submission may already have been saved. Checking…

messages.text: Sign in to continue
messages.when: The database found nobody signed in.

messages.text: Finish signing in: type the code from your authenticator app
messages.when: Your account uses two-step sign-in and the code was not typed yet.
messages.do: Type the code from your authenticator app.

messages.text: You do not have permission to do this (needs {1})

messages.do: Ask the owner or a manager to do it, or to give you the role.

messages.text: You do not have permission to do that.
messages.when: The database refused the action for your roles.

messages.text: That has already been recorded.

title: Point of Sale — taking payment
summary: How the money is taken: cash with change, card, the café's own ways to pay (FIB, FastPay…), dollars, split between ways, a delivery platform's order, the service charge, tips and loyalty rewards; the receipt after, and what to do when the connection drops during payment.

who.can: Everything on the till: sell, discount with no limit, approve other people's discounts and over-stock sales with their PIN, cancel bills with items, cancel pre-orders, take offline sales off the till, edit tables, see the cost of a sale.
The same as the owner on this screen.
The same as the owner on this screen (discounts, approvals, cancelling bills and pre-orders, edit tables, cost of a sale).

Sell, take payment every way, keep bills open, split and move bills, give discounts up to the discount limit, add customers and addresses, take and collect pre-orders, give away a staff meal / on the house / sample, open, close and hand over their own drawer, clock in and out.
who.cannot: Give a discount over the limit without a manager's PIN; cancel a bill that has items on it; change the discount on a printed bill; cancel a pre-order; take a refused offline sale off the till; edit tables; see costs.

who.can: The same selling as a cashier, and the drawer.
who.cannot: Give any discount (no Discount link), and everything a cashier cannot.

get_there: Menu → Operations → POS. A cashier lands here after signing in. Also: Sales → Open POS. Press Cash, Card or a way to pay under the order's total, or F2 / F4.
before: For cash or dollars: the drawer is open. Pressing Cash with the drawer closed opens the drawer window instead, saying "Open the drawer first: count the cash in it. A card sale needs no drawer."
For dollars: a manager set today's rate on Sales → Dollars (it is used for 36 hours by default).
For the café's own ways to pay: added on Settings → Ways to pay.
For direct delivery: a customer with an address on the order.

controls.label: $ Dollars

controls.label: Split
controls.does: Two rows to begin with (Card and Cash, or Card and the first way to pay): each a way ("How payment {n} is made") and an amount ("Amount of payment {n}"); the last takes what is left. controls.rules: Only one cash part. Amounts are whole dinars, each above 0, together the total.
controls.after: Each part goes to its own account; only the cash part goes in the drawer.

controls.label: {platform} order number

controls.rules: Required. Letters and digits only. Up to 60.

controls.label: Back
controls.does: Closes the window; nothing is recorded (also Esc or tapping outside).

controls.label: Confirm payment · {total}
controls.does: Records the sale once, at the total shown.
controls.rules: Off while cash is short, the platform number is missing or wrong, the split or dollars do not add up, or the tip is wrong. Enter does the same. Pressing it twice never records twice.
controls.after: Quick sale: the order, stock used by each line's recipe for this way of selling (with add-ons and packaging), and one journal: Dr the payment accounts / Cr 4000 Sales (Dr 4100 for a discount), Cr 4300 service charge, Cr 2200 tip; Dr 5000 Cost of goods sold / Cr 1200 Inventory. A bill: the same, and the bill leaves the open bills. The customer earns points. The sale shows on Orders, Sales, the Dashboard and reports at once.

title: Point of Sale — tables and open bills
summary: Orders kept open to be paid later: a table's bill, or a bill under a customer's name. Add to them over time, send the bar a ticket, print the bill for the customer, split it between payers, move it to another table, cancel it, and pay it.

who.can: Everything on the till: sell, discount with no limit, approve other people's discounts and over-stock sales with their PIN, cancel bills with items, cancel pre-orders, take offline sales off the till, edit tables, see the cost of a sale.

The same as the owner on this screen (discounts, approvals, cancelling bills and pre-orders, edit tables, cost of a sale).

who.cannot: Give a discount over the limit without a manager's PIN; cancel a bill that has items on it; change the discount on a printed bill; cancel a pre-order; take a refused offline sale off the till; edit tables; see costs.

who.can: The same selling as a cashier, and the drawer.
who.cannot: Give any discount (no Discount link), and everything a cashier cannot.

get_there: Menu → Operations → POS. A cashier lands here after signing in. Also: Sales → Open POS. Then the Tables tab (opens first on a till with tables), or a bill's chip in the top bar.
before: Tables are set up with Edit tables (owner, general manager, branch manager) — or bills are kept by customer name only.
A bill is not a sale: nothing reaches the books, the stock or the drawer until it is paid.

title: Point of Sale — the drawer, clocking and printing
summary: The cash drawer in sessions: opened by counting it, closed by counting again, handed to the next person, or closed for someone by a manager. Also clocking in and out with a PIN, and how this till prints.

who.can: Open, close (any session), hand over, close it for them, put cash in from the safe, see what the drawer should hold.
Open, close any session, hand over, close it for them, put cash in from the safe.
who.cannot: See what an open drawer should hold before counting.

who.can: Open the drawer, close and hand over their own session, clock in and out.
who.cannot: Close someone else's session; put cash in from the safe; see what the drawer should hold.

get_there: Menu → Operations → POS. A cashier lands here after signing in. Also: Sales → Open POS. Then the drawer button (Session {no} / Open the drawer), the clock button, or the printer button.

parts.shows: "The drawer". Open: "The drawer is open: session {no}, {cashier}'s, since {when}" and, for those who may see it, "It should hold {amount} · cash sales …, card …, {n} orders". Closed: "The drawer is closed" and "Cash is taken only while it is open: open it by counting the cash in it." When offline sales wait: "{n} sales made offline are not sent yet: the drawer is counted once they are, so its cash agrees." (no buttons then).

controls.does: Starts the count: "Count what is in the drawer now, before putting anything in. Its difference from what the last session left is shown once the count is in."

controls.label: Close the drawer

controls.who: The session's cashier, or a manager.
controls.after: "Session {no} is closed. It should have held {expected}; counted {counted}: {difference}. {taken} to the {place}; {left} stays in the drawer." Over/short to 6300 (journal shown); takings Dr 1005 or 1020 / Cr 1000. Cash sales are no longer voidable after this. The figures line shows cash sales, refunds, voids, paid out, put in, taken out, card, orders.

parts.name: How this works
parts.shows: "A sale is never edited. A sale rung in error is voided until the drawer's session holding it closes — revenue, payment, cost and stock all come back exactly. After that, money goes back to the customer by a refund of some of its items or all of them, through Sales returns, the way it was paid; only goods that can go back on the shelf return to stock. Both take a reason from the list and are on the audit trail; one approved by a second person (their name and PIN) is marked so, and one without waits for the owner on the exceptions report."

summary: The café's delivery platforms (Talabat and others): which are in use and priced, what each owes for orders sold and not yet paid out, matching a platform's statement to those orders and posting the payout, and the platform sales.

who.can: Add, rename, take out of use and bring back a platform; copy prices and packaging; match and post statements; cancel a posted statement.
See everything and match a statement.
who.cannot: Manage platforms; post or cancel a payout.

who.can: See; match, post and cancel statements.
See; match a statement (nothing is written).

before: Platform sales are rung up on the till with the platform's way of selling and its order number.

parts.name: How this works
parts.shows: "A delivery-platform order is platform-paid: the customer pays the platform, and the sale sits in 1100 Platform receivable until the platform pays out. Each sale carries the order number from the platform's tablet, and the platform's statement is matched to the sales by it. Direct delivery is not a platform sale — it is taken as cash or card."

controls.label: How this works
controls.does: Opens or folds it.

parts.name: Your Delivery Platforms
parts.shows: "Each platform in use has its own button on the till, its own prices, the packaging its orders take, and its own order numbers and statements": Platform (name, short name, other names), Status (In use / Not in use), Products priced ("No prices yet: the till offers it once a product has one"), Orders waiting. Others see "The owner or the general manager adds a platform, renames one or takes one out of use."

controls.label: Edit…
controls.does: "Name, as its customers know it" and "Name in {language}" for each other language, then Save / Cancel ("Saved.").
controls.rules: Up to 60 letters each.

controls.label: Copy prices & packaging…
controls.does: "Its orders take the packaging of" (another way of selling), "and its prices too, from today (change them on Products & Recipes)", then Copy.
controls.rules: "The recipe lines that channel's orders take go with this platform's orders too; a product with no price here takes that channel's, from today."
controls.after: "{prices} product prices and {lines} packaging lines copied." The till offers the platform once products have prices.

controls.label: Take out of use…
controls.does: "{name} leaves the till and sells nothing more. What it owes, and its statements, stay here." Take it out of use / Keep it.
controls.after: "{name} is out of use." Its button leaves the till.

controls.label: Bring back into use
controls.does: "{name} is back in use."

controls.label: + Add a delivery platform
controls.does: "A new delivery platform": Name, as its customers know it (e.g. Lezzoo), Name in {language}, Its orders take the packaging of (or "Nothing yet: set it up later"), and its prices too…, Short name (optional) ("Small Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter. Made from the name when left empty; it cannot be changed later."), Add the platform / Cancel.
controls.after: "{name} is added." (and what was copied). A new button on the till once priced.

parts.name: Owed by the Platforms
parts.shows: "Each order sold and not yet paid out, by its number": Waiting to be paid out ("{n} orders, at their price on the till"), 1100 Platform receivable ("what the books say the platforms owe"), Not explained by any order (with why); per platform "{n} orders · the oldest {when}, {n} days ago"; a table Platform, Order, Sold, Days waiting, Sold for.

parts.name: Match a Statement
parts.shows: "The platform's statement against the orders waiting · nothing is posted until you say so".

controls.label: Platform
controls.does: Which platform the statement is from (the one with most orders waiting to begin with).

controls.label: Read it from its file…
controls.does: Reads the platform's report from an Excel or CSV file ("Read from {file}").
controls.rules: Up to 10 MB.

controls.label: The statement
controls.does: Or paste its rows with their column names: Order, Payout, and Commission and Fees if it gives them. Shows "{n} lines read · columns: … · {n} total rows left out · {n} other rows left out: titles and notes".
controls.rules: Up to 2,000 lines.

controls.label: Match to the orders waiting
controls.does: Matches line by line (nothing is written): Orders matched ("worth {amount} at the till"), Paid for them ("commission {commission} · fees {fees}"), Not explained, On lines not posted ("{n} lines need a word in the note"); a table per line: Line, Order, What it is (Matched / No sale has this order number / Already paid out (by statement {ref}) / The sale was voided or refunded / On the statement twice), Sold for, Paid, Commission, Fees, Not explained; orders missing from the statement; and "The journal it would post".

controls.label: Statement number or date
controls.does: Required, up to 80.

controls.label: The payout arrived on
controls.does: Up to today.

controls.label: Note (optional) / Note: say what the lines that do not match are
controls.does: Required (3+ letters) when some lines do not match.
controls.rules: Up to 500.

controls.label: Post the payout
controls.does: Posts it.
controls.who: Owner, general manager, accountant. Others see "The owner or the accountant posts the payout."
controls.after: "Posted (journal {journal}): {n} {platform} orders paid out." Dr 1020 Bank with the payout, Dr 5100 Platform commission and 5200 Platform fees, Cr 1100 Platform receivable with the orders' value; the orders leave "Owed".

parts.name: Statements Posted
parts.shows: "Newest first · a cancelled one is kept, marked": Statement (platform, reference, "orders of {period}", note), Arrived, Orders paid ("of {n} lines"), Paid for them, Journal, By.

controls.label: Cancel… / Why it is cancelled / Cancel it / Keep
controls.does: Cancels a posted statement with a reason (3+ letters).
controls.after: "Cancelled: its journal is reversed, and its orders wait again."

parts.name: Platform Sales
parts.shows: "Among the last 500 sales · margin before the platform's commission": Platform sales shown, Their net sales, Before commission; a table Sale, When, Platform, Items, Net, COGS, Before commission.
